description.en: The list of speech corpus to be deleted.
The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh: 语料标识。调用[QuerySpeech](~~217577~~)可以查询语料标识。
description.en: The corpus identifier. You can call [QuerySpeech](~~217577~~) to query the corpus identifier.

description.zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符。可以调用[QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~)查询设备ID。
description.en: The ID issued by the IoT Platform to the device. This ID is the Unique Identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~) to query the Device ID.

description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot delete-device-speech --iot-id 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --device-speech-list AudioFormat=wav BizCode=identifying --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot DeleteDeviceSpeech --region cn-hangzhou --IotId 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --DeviceSpeechList.1.AudioFormat wav --DeviceSpeechList.1.BizCode identifying
